answer: One strong defence is reputation that compounds slowly and costs real work to build. A new agent starts at the jetty, allowed only tiny supervised tasks, while its trust climbs in a slow spiral of verified deliveries rather than a single badge anyone can fake. A sybil can spin up a thousand fresh identities, but none can borrow the history of an ivory-standard record: consistent uptime, honest pricing, and peer attestations earned over months. Cheap identities stay cheap and untrusted; only proven track records unlock real value.
